dedupe_keys.name: hydrolib core d hydro file interface

description: HYDROLIB-core is Deltares' Python library for reading and writing D-HYDRO model files. Its wrappers expose model inputs and outputs for use in preprocessing, postprocessing and hydrodynamic modelling workflows. The repository links installation instructions, tutorials, a supported-functionality list and an API reference. Users work with their own configured model files, so geographic coverage is global and temporal or spatial resolution follows the hydrodynamic model, not the library. Public source and the PyPI package are free under MIT. A limitation is that file-interface support is version- and format-dependent; the library is not itself a numerical flow solver, and users should check its documented support list. It can automate preparation and interpretation around Delft3D FM (model-delft3d-fm) and related D-HYDRO workflows. The separate HYDROLIB package builds on this core but does not replace its standalone interface. This review confirmed the repository and documentation routes. It did not parse model files, obtain a solver or establish compatibility with every D-HYDRO release.
